name: Flakeroll
subtitle: Roll snow, stack the snowman
shortDescription: Drag a snowball over snow and mud until it is exactly the right size, then stack the snowman: 100 yards, each world with its own rule.
longDescription:
Flakeroll is a snowball puzzle about exact sizes. Put a finger anywhere in a toy-village yard and drag: the snowball follows, swelling over fresh snow and shrinking in bare mud. At the far end a ghost snowman shows the size of each piece. Roll a ball of exactly that size onto the wooden plinth and it stacks, then a new little ball appears on the red rug for the next piece.

### 100 Yards In Ten Worlds
Every world teaches one new rule, so the puzzle keeps changing shape.
- First Frost and Mudflats: snow adds one, mud takes one away.
- Frozen Pond: ice sends the ball sliding until something stops it.
- Deep Powder adds two, while Sunny Slope slush shrinks you by two.
- Garden Gates let only little balls through, and Plow Lanes only open one way.
- Gusty Hollow shoves you a cell further, and Snow Tunnels come in pairs.
- Grand Parade uses every rule at once.

### More To Roll
- Daily Yard: a fresh yard every day, the same for everyone, with a streak.
- Blizzard Run: chain up to twelve yards on six flames; every undo or restart burns one.
- Wardrobe: free coins from stars and Daily Yards buy hats and scarves for the finished snowman. No random boxes, no coin packs.
- Path hint: golden footprints show one way home when you are stuck.

No timers, no lives, unlimited undo and restart. A music-box lullaby, optional haptics, a calm-motion setting and big touch targets on iPhone and iPad.
whatsNew: Version 1.0 launch: 100 snowman yards in ten worlds, a Daily Yard, Blizzard Run and a Wardrobe of hats and scarves earned with free coins.

At the far end a ghost snowman shows the size of each piece. Roll a ball of exactly that size onto the wooden plinth and it stacks, then a new little ball appears on the red rug for the next piece.
